description: Guided onboarding: user says 'help me connect my sensor' without details. Agent must walk them through MQTT onboarding - discover device types, create the device, give connection info, and verify. Tests the guided-onboarding experience (no extension needed).

turns.user: I want to connect my temperature sensor to NeoMind over MQTT. Can you guide me through setting it up?
Yes please, walk me through it.

per_turn: Turn 1: Agent discovers device types (`neomind device types list`) and explains the MQTT onboarding path
Turn 2: Agent creates the device (`neomind device create --name ... --device-type temp_sensor --adapter-type mqtt`), gives the MQTT topic/connection info, and verifies
expectations.overall: Device must be created via MQTT adapter and the agent must provide connection guidance (topic/broker) - a complete guided onboarding, not just a bare create.
